name: Vishnu
source:
Comes from: somewhere in the continental Asia

The first Goddess that Yutaka encounters, she refers to him as to her husband. She is very unsuspicious of people and believes Yutaka to be a special existence who will save them all. Beautiful, kind and gentle, she is the very personification of the word "goddess." Loved by anyone, she loves everyone dearly.

However, she is quite the airhead and careless despite her all-capable appearances, and happens to fail because of her abundant lust. Although she seems like she never gets angry, once she snaps she immediately punches the one who angered her. Ever since she came to Yutaka's family shrine she has become the most popular miko.
